What's your return and refund policy?

Dermalogica's Virtual Assistant · AI says:

Our policy is to gladly accept returns for any Dermalogica.com purchase for any reason.

Timing: Start your return within 30 days of your order date to be eligible for a refund.
Cost: No return shipping, handling, or restocking fees when using our provided label.
Item condition: Only new or gently used items in original packaging are eligible. Items that are nearly empty, damaged from personal use, lost, or tampered/filled with other substances are not refundable.
Final sale items (not refundable):
Partial kits or gift sets
Free samples
Gift-with-purchase items
Rewards items
How to return: Use our online returns center to generate a prepaid UPS shipping label, repackage your items with the packing slip, and drop at UPS. Once we receive your return, we will process your refund or replacement.
Order cancellations: Because orders process quickly, we generally cannot cancel or modify processed orders. If you don’t want the order, you can still return it through the online returns center for a full refund on items marked for return once they’re received.
Points & rewards: If you return a product or an order is canceled, any loyalty points earned from that purchase (and any tier upgrade from those points) will be reversed or reduced accordingly.

Based on this, our return and refund policy allows you to return most Dermalogica.com purchases within 30 days for a refund, as long as they meet the condition requirements and are not final sale items.
